spatial_rubric.zone: Must mention wafer perimeter, outer edge, periphery, edge region, or edge zone as the affected area; must also indicate the interior or center is comparatively sparse or lower density.
spatial_rubric.distribution: Must describe defects as concentrated along the wafer perimeter in a near-continuous ring around the outer edge, with no strong center-localized cluster.
spatial_rubric.clock_position: Must indicate fairly uniform coverage around most clock positions or around the full circumference; no single dominant clock position is specified.
spatial_rubric.coordinates_hint: No explicit x/y coordinates are given; acceptable coordinate reference is radial/peripheral only, such as outer radius, wafer edge, circumference, or rim.

morphology_rubric.pattern_type: Must mention edge-ring, circumferential band, perimeter ring, rim ring, or near-continuous ring pattern.
morphology_rubric.density: Must describe high-density defect pixels along the edge/ring and much lower density or sparse defects in the interior.
morphology_rubric.geometric_structure: Must describe a thin circular or circumferential band following the wafer edge; slight irregularity around the ring is acceptable.
morphology_rubric.texture_description: Must mention pixelated and/or slightly irregular texture, with possible localized brightening at a few edge segments.

summary: Near-continuous edge-ring defect pattern with high-density defects concentrated at the wafer periphery, fairly uniform around most clock positions, and much lower defect density in the interior.
